daily.title: COP31 summit targets major electrification push as 1.5C goal slips away
daily.summary: The climate summit will push for nations around the world to electrify their energy faster and move away from fossil fuels, as Chris Bowen predicts global temperatures will rise to 2.6 degrees above pre-industrial levels.

daily.title: Breaking: Russell Brand jailed for more than 10 years for rape and sexual assault
